lead.event: Ultrajaya plans rights issue to fund Frisian Flag acquisition and transfer control
lead.headline: ULTJ plans Rp16.94 trillion rights issue to acquire Frisian Flag and transfer control
lead.blurb: Ultra Jaya plans to issue up to 7.88 billion shares at Rp2,150 each, with 86.01% of proceeds earmarked for the acquisition and the balance for working capital. The 100% acquisition of Frisian Flag Indonesia is valued at Rp14.57 trillion and will be paid for with shares, making FrieslandCampina International Holding (FCIH) ULTJ’s controlling shareholder. FCIH must make a mandatory tender offer for ULTJ’s remaining public shares. Shareholders will vote on the plan on 6 November, with completion targeted by 31 January 2027.

market_structure_policy.event: OJK reports October capital-market investor growth
market_structure_policy.headline: OJK reports October capital-market investors rise by 1.38 million
market_structure_policy.blurb: The total reached 33.55 million, up 64.75% year to date, while the IHSG fell 16.7% in October. OJK lowered the lower price limit from 15% to 7% through 31 December 2026 and extended buybacks without a general shareholders meeting through 30 June 2027.

market_structure_policy.event: IDX places CBRE and LAPD on Full-Call Auction Board for negative equity
market_structure_policy.headline: IDX places CBRE and LAPD on Full-Call Auction Board for negative equity
market_structure_policy.blurb: Cakra Buana Resources Energi and Leyand International entered the IDX’s special-monitoring list on 4 November under Criterion 5 for negative equity in their latest financial statements. CBRE’s Rp1.27 trillion rights issue, offering 11.79 billion to 11.8 billion shares at Rp108 each, remains in document completion and OJK evaluation.

market_structure_policy.event: OJK calculates potential investor compensation in DSSA, BREN, and CUAN cases
market_structure_policy.headline: OJK calculates potential compensation in DSSA, BREN, CUAN cases after Rp2.1 trillion fines
market_structure_policy.blurb: OJK is identifying eligible investors and how much each could receive, but the mechanism and compensation amounts are not confirmed. It imposed fines of Rp1.5 trillion on Dian Swastatika Sentosa, Rp500 billion on Barito Renewables Energy and Rp100 billion on Petrindo Jaya Kreasi.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: ITMG plans Rp2.311 trillion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: ITMG plans share buyback of up to Rp2.311 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The program will run from 5 November to 4 February 2027, funded entirely from internal cash. Combined with shares retained from the previous buyback, repurchased shares will not exceed 20% of capital, while free-float requirements remain observed.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: ISSP announces a Rp150 billion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: ISSP announces a Rp150 billion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Shares rose 5.9% in the first trading session on 5 November. Steel Pipe Industry plans to repurchase about 250 million shares, or 3.48% of issued shares, at up to Rp600 each using internal cash, and hold them as treasury stock. The buyback is scheduled to run through 5 February 2027, with MNC Sekuritas.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: INPS plans a controlling-shareholder private placement
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: INPS plans Rp125 billion placement to controlling shareholder
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Indah Prakasa Sentosa's estimated free float is 11.68%, below the IDX's 15% minimum. It plans to issue up to 1.25 billion shares at Rp100 each to GIGP, lifting the controlling shareholder's stake from 65.86% to 88.32%. GIGP has committed to sell shares to the public to restore free float to at least 15%.

capital_raising_buybacks.headline: ANDA launches IPO bookbuilding for up to Rp316.76 billion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Andalan Artha Primanusa is offering up to 1.68 billion new shares at Rp158 to Rp189 each, plus up to 239.43 million Series I Warrants at a ratio of one per seven shares. Bookbuilding runs through 17 November, with the public offering set for 24–27 November and listing on 1 December.

other.headline: SMAR announces Rp490-per-share interim dividend
other.blurb: Sinar Mas Agro Resources and Technology plans to distribute Rp1.4 trillion for fiscal 2026, equal to 34.65% of its Rp4.06 trillion net profit for the nine months ended 30 September. It last paid an interim dividend of Rp105 per share for fiscal 2024. The cum-dividend date is 12 November, and payment is scheduled for 26 November.

other.event: Pefindo downgrades WIKA's bond rating after a missed coupon payment
other.headline: Pefindo cuts WIKA bond rating to idD after delayed coupon payment
other.blurb: The downgrade takes WIKA's Continuation III Phase I bond from idCCC to idD after its coupon due on 3 November was delayed. Pefindo kept the corporate rating at idSD and may review ratings if overdue principal, coupon and profit-sharing obligations are settled.

other.event: Fitch downgrades Pos Indonesia's sukuk after a missed payment
other.headline: Fitch downgrades Pos Indonesia's Rp1 trillion sukuk to default
other.blurb: Pos Indonesia failed to pay ijarah returns due 8 October, and its 14-working-day grace period expired. The Series A, B and C sukuk were its last outstanding issuance, leaving it in default on all its issuances. It canceled its 17 November bondholder and obligor meeting pending audited financial statements.

deals_control.event: Garuda plans a third rights issue with GMFI shares contributed by Danantara
deals_control.headline: GIAA plans third rights issue of up to Rp16.91 trillion with GMFI shares from Danantara
deals_control.blurb: Danantara will exercise its rights with 82.10 billion GMFI shares valued at Rp5.66 trillion, and non-participants face dilution of up to 37.92%. An appraisal valued the shares at Rp8.61 trillion, against the Rp5.66 trillion contribution value. Garuda Indonesia shareholders vote on 6 November, and the issue needs an effective OJK statement.

deals_control.event: KB Bank completes sale of 85% stake in KB Bukopin Finance
deals_control.headline: BBKP completes sale of 85% stake in KB Bukopin Finance for Rp339.97 billion
deals_control.blurb: The 4 November sale to JB Woori Capital reduced KB Bank’s ownership to 14.24%. The bank said the divestment would add liquidity, optimize capital allocation and strengthen its focus on core banking.

earnings_guidance.event: Janu Putra Sejahtera swings to Q3 net profit
earnings_guidance.headline: AYAM swings to Q3 net profit of Rp17.58 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Janu Putra Sejahtera reversed a year-earlier loss for the period ended 30 September. Sales fell 9.82% to Rp203.28 billion, while cost of goods sold declined 17.64% to Rp192.66 billion.

earnings_guidance.event: PANI reports Rp3 trillion in marketing sales and continues PIK2 development
earnings_guidance.headline: PANI reports Rp3 trillion in marketing sales and continues PIK2 development
earnings_guidance.blurb: Through September, residential sales contributed Rp1.63 trillion, up 34% year on year and equal to 54% of the total. Commercial sales were Rp526 billion, while CBD PIK2 land plots contributed Rp866 billion. Sugianto Kusuma said the company remains focused on PIK2’s ecosystem, with NICE operating and the Hilton PIK2 hotel under construction.

earnings_guidance.event: ANTM's nine-month performance drives broker reassessments and share rebound
earnings_guidance.headline: ANTM reports Rp8.84 trillion nine-month profit as BRI Danareksa lifts target to Rp4,500
earnings_guidance.blurb: Aneka Tambang's January–September net profit rose 47.9% year on year, while revenue increased 22.8% to Rp88.48 trillion. Maybank, UBS and Samuel Sekuritas maintained Buy ratings with targets of Rp3,900, Rp3,950 and Rp4,000, respectively. Shares closed at Rp2,600 on 4 November, up 8.33% after hitting a year-to-date low of Rp2,400 on 3 November.

earnings_guidance.event: PGEO reports nine-month profit growth and targets 1 GW capacity by 2028
earnings_guidance.headline: PGEO reports 21.45% nine-month profit growth, targets 1 GW by 2028
earnings_guidance.blurb: Pertamina Geothermal Energy plans to raise own-operation capacity from 727 MW to 1 GW by 2028, prioritizing 12 projects totaling 320 MW. Hululais Units 1 and 2 target commercial operation in 2028 under a Steam Sales Contract.

macro_flows.event: Global oil prices plunge amid expectations of US-Iran war ending
macro_flows.headline: Global oil prices plunge more than 8% on hopes of US-Iran war ending
macro_flows.blurb: Brent closed at US$94.62 a barrel and WTI at US$88.12, both their lowest closes since 31 August. Markets grew hopeful that Democrats’ capture of both chambers of Congress and Trump’s statement that the US had no immediate plan to attack Iran could hasten a diplomatic resolution.
